description: This file defines a utility class 'EcuDefinitionInheritanceList' that provides methods to retrieve a list of ECU ROM inheritance nodes from an XML DOM document. It includes methods to traverse ECU definition inheritance hierarchy based on CAL IDs and extract relevant XML node information.

classes.name: EcuDefinitionInheritanceList
classes.description: Utility class for retrieving ECU definition inheritance nodes from XML DOM documents.

methods.name: getInheritanceList
methods.description: Returns a list of Node objects representing the inheritance hierarchy for a given ECU definition, starting with the specified ECU and traversing to its base definitions.

methods.name: getBaseRomId
methods.description: Private helper method that retrieves the CAL ID of the base ROM for a given CAL ID by evaluating XPath expressions on the XML document.

methods.name: getBaseRomIdNode
methods.description: Private helper method that retrieves the 'rom' XML node corresponding to a specific CAL ID.
